summary: Comprehensive implementation plan incorporating all 30+ HTML screen specifications across both design files into MarketPulse, including the Desktop Landing Page, Unified Price Map & Discovery Hub (National Map, LGA Choropleth, Market Pin Detail Sheet, Commodity Price Comparison with radius slider, Basket Comparison with coverage gates), Weekly Wrap-up Report with WhatsApp sharing, Trip Summary with First-Trip toggle, Silent Backup + Google Cloud Sync, and full cross-browser optimization for Safari, Chrome, and Samsung Internet.
